# Daydreamers Film Society

> An independent student film collective and cinema exhibition platform based at RV University, Bengaluru.

## About
Daydreamers Film Society is dedicated to the preservation, exploration, and creation of cinematic storytelling. The society hosts curated screenings, 24-hour and 48-hour filmmaking challenges, direction and cinematography workshops, and student-produced film exhibitions. The society operates a 70-seat cinema auditorium with custom cryptographic QR admission ticketing.

## Canonical Pages & Links
- [Home](https://daydreamersfilm.com/): Society landing page, artistic manifesto, past exhibitions, filmmaking departments, and student directory.
- [Screening & Box Office](https://daydreamersfilm.com/screening): Real-time auditorium seat selection, schedule carousel, and student ticket reservations.
- [Contact & Legal](https://daydreamersfilm.com/contact): Institutional queries, exhibition guidelines, and legal disclosures.

## Admission & Ticketing Guidelines
- Attendance is exclusively for institutional members with valid `@rvu.edu.in` or `@blr.rvu.edu.in` email credentials.
- Limit of one ticket per student USN per showing.
- Group bookings support up to 4 contiguous seats.
- Each ticket is cryptographically signed with HMAC-SHA256 and verified at the door.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, modern CSS3, native ES Modules.
- **3D Graphics**: Three.js (r160) for interactive 3D WebGL scenes, procedural materials, and optical effects.
- **Motion**: GSAP for sweeping wall camera transitions.
- **Backend**: Node.js & Express REST API running serverless on Vercel with Supabase PostgreSQL.
- **Source Code**: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/DAYDREAMERS-FILM-COLLECTIVE/DayDreamers-Film-Direction)
